text: Knowz 是面向 DSH web 客户端的知识库插件，通过 MCP 客户端连接托管 Knowz vault，并由入口模块把打包的技能注册到 DSH。用户可查询和语义搜索团队知识、浏览 vault 与近期条目、保存或修订知识记录，也能设置 vault 路由并检查连接状态。适合需要在 agent 工作中查找和沉淀团队决策、约定与技术背景的用户。使用时需要配置 KNOWZ_API_KEY；查询和写入通过 mcp.knowz.io 提供。

Knowz connects DSH web to hosted vaults over MCP and registers bundled skills. Agents can query, search, browse, save or amend team knowledge, map vaults, and check connection status. Requires KNOWZ_API_KEY; requests go to mcp.knowz.io.
我想让 agent 回答问题时参考团队过去的决策和技术约定。
有没有办法在多个知识库里语义检索相关方案和过往实践？
Help me save a durable engineering decision into the right team knowledge vault.
Knowz 的功能「团队知识问答与检索」：agent 可按 vault 路由规则查询知识，或跨 vault 语义搜索并查看相关条目。通过运行对应技能触发，结果可结合已存决策、约定和技术资料回答问题。
Knowz 使用前须知：必须配置 KNOWZ_API_KEY，入口 bundle 将其作为 Bearer 凭据附加到托管 MCP 请求。（见 cordis.patch.yml:7-9）
Knowz 使用前须知：知识查询和保存操作通过 mcp.knowz.io 的托管 MCP 服务执行，相关查询内容或待保存内容会发送至该服务。（见 cordis.patch.yml:5-9）

dsh-knowz README · Knowz：Knowz AI plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. Product name: **Knowz**. Publisher: **Knowz AI**.

Connects agents to hosted Knowz vaults over MCP. This plugin is **knowledge only**. For TDD / quality gates, install **[KnowzCode](https://github.com/knowz-io/deepseek-knowzcode-plugin)** separately — do not merge the two.

Official discovery is the GitHub topic [dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin). There is **no DeepSeek store**.

dsh-knowz README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:knowz-io/deepseek-knowz-plugin
```

Then create a `ukz_` key at [https://app.knowz.io/settings/api-keys](https://app.knowz.io/settings/api-keys), set `KNOWZ_API_KEY` in the environment or `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, and restart `dsh web`.

```sh
export KNOWZ_API_KEY=ukz_…
```

Do not paste API keys in chat. Do not run `/knowz register` on an existing Knowz account — that creates a **new** account. `/knowz register` is not the existing-user login path.

dsh-knowz README · Auth：The shipped MCP row interpolates `process.env.KNOWZ_API_KEY` into `Authorization: Bearer`. Export + restart is the path that attaches the header. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` is the DSH-managed store; it is not automatically materialized into `process.env`.

OAuth is not in this first slice.

dsh-knowz README · Auth：Personal + business tenants: two MCP rows with unique `serverName` values and two env refs. Same URL `https://mcp.knowz.io/mcp` is fine. Duplicate `serverName` fails at load. See [MULTI-ACCOUNT.md](./MULTI-ACCOUNT.md).

dsh-knowz README · MCP：Official client: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. Hosted endpoint: `https://mcp.knowz.io/mcp` (HTTP JSON-RPC / streamable HTTP).

No secrets, `CLIENT_ID`, literal bearer token, or `x-api-key` in this package.

After the key is set, ask the agent to run the `knowz-setup` skill to map vaults.

dsh-knowz README · Skills：`knowz-ask`, `knowz-save`, `knowz-search`, `knowz-browse`, `knowz-amend`, `knowz-setup`, `knowz-status`, `knowz-flush`, `knowz-auto`

DeepSeek Harness does not ship Cursor-style slash-command files. Ask the agent to run the skill by name.
